import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(csv_file_path, col1_name="column1", col2_name="column2"):
    """
    Read a CSV file, group by one column, compute the mean of another column,
    and generate a bar plot of the grouped means.

    Parameters
    ----------
    csv_file_path : str
        Path to the CSV file.
    col1_name : str, default "column1"
        Name of the column to group by.
    col2_name : str, default "column2"
        Name of the column to compute the mean for.

    Returns
    -------
    matplotlib.axes.Axes
        The Axes object containing the generated bar plot.
    """
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_file_path)
    grouped_means = df.groupby(col1_name)[col2_name].mean()

    ax = grouped_means.plot(kind="bar")
    ax.set_title(f"Mean of {col2_name} Grouped by {col1_name}")
    ax.set_xlabel(col1_name)
    ax.set_ylabel(f"Mean of {col2_name}")

    return ax
